photoCredit.description: Photographer credit for this image, e.g. "Qwerqu Mcbrew / Unsplash". The site renders it over the bottom of the photo as "Photo By: …" — type only the name, not the "Photo By:" prefix. Leave blank to fall back to the image's Caption in the Media Library, then to a photographer encoded in the filename.

photoUrl.description: Optional override URL — used by the bootstrap seed to point at pre-existing /public/images/* assets without uploading via the Media Library. Editors should use the `photo` media field; frontend reads `photo.url ?? photoUrl`.

isPrimary.description: Renders this card with the filled-yellow primary treatment.
